frontend_rule: Show bridge deposit/redemption as unavailable. Do not instruct a user to send or burn funds based on this offline contract.
purpose: Ownership-authenticated request intake and transaction-locator deduplication. It does not verify chain receipts or release funds.

local_library_operations.result: A server-generated nonce, exact intent and exact UTF-8 ownership-proof message. No request is accepted yet.
Verifies an Ed25519 ownership signature, atomically consumes the issued nonce and returns REQUESTED. Exact retries return the same request ID.
An exact ownership-proof message binding one top-level source-chain instruction to the accepted request.
Verifies the original source owner's signature and reserves the chain/transaction/instruction tuple globally. Status is EVIDENCE_DECLARED, not confirmed.
Internal status only. A future public adapter must authenticate status access before calling this method.

deposit.source_owner: Solana source-token authority and ownership-proof signer
deposit.destination_owner: Xeris account to receive xUSDC after independently verified deposit and approved issuance
deposit.solana_token_account: Source Solana USDC token account; mint and authority require independent on-chain verification

redeem.source_owner: Xeris xUSDC holder and ownership-proof signer
redeem.solana_token_account: Requested destination USDC account; mint and authority require independent on-chain verification

signing.canonical_json: Recursively sort object keys lexicographically, no whitespace, ordinary JSON scalars. Approved fields are ASCII. amount_raw is a canonical positive decimal string, never a float.
signing.locator_prefix:
Xeris transaction locator ownership proof
xeris-mainnet-usdc-operator-locator-v1
signing.message_bytes: UTF-8 prefix followed immediately by canonical JSON, with no trailing newline
signing.intent_digest: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the complete intent signing-message bytes
signing.warning: Ownership proof only. Never sign this message with a treasury, reserve or producer key. It is not a chain transaction and cannot authorize settlement.
